title: Hobbies
description: Talk about free-time activities and what you enjoy doing.

introduction.headline: Talk about your hobbies
introduction.body: Learn words for free-time activities and say what you like doing.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara parole per le attività del tempo libero e di' cosa ti piace fare.
objectives: Read a short text about free time

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il mio hobby preferito è cucinare.

vocabulary.example: We often go to the cinema.
I enjoy reading in the evening.
She plays sport twice a week.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Fa sport due volte a settimana.

options: I enjoy reading in the evening.
I enjoy to reading in the evening.
I enjoy read in the evening.
I enjoying reading in the evening.
exercises.answer: I enjoy reading in the evening.

exercises.prompt: We often go to the ____ on Friday.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: We often go to the ____ on Friday.
exercises.explanation: Cinema is the place where you watch films.
A hobby is an activity you do for fun in your free time.

review.tip: Tell a friend two hobbies you enjoy using enjoy + -ing.
